extDescription.message: Export the UPF calendar to Google Calendar or as an .ics file.

formatBlockGroupHint.message: Prefix is added to the group number. E.g. Group: or G:

formatBlockRoomHint.message: You can add a prefix like Room or trailing text.

help1.message: Open the UPF virtual secretary (recommended for better accuracy) or gestioacadèmica.

help5.message: Select the subjects you want to export.

help6.message: Enable Create one .ics per selected subject if you want to import each subject into a different calendar.

help8.message: The .ics file is a calendar file; it should theoretically work in any calendar app, although it has only been thoroughly tested in Google Calendar.

help9.message: To import it into Google Calendar, go to Settings → Import & export → Import, select the .ics file and choose the calendar where you want to add the events.

helpImportant.message: IMPORTANT: To get colors in Google Calendar, create one calendar per subject and assign a different color to each calendar. Then import each subject's .ics into its corresponding calendar.

importErrorNote.message: If Google Calendar shows the error “Could not import this file. Please try again later.”, wait 10 seconds and click import again.

privacyNotice.message: The extension processes data locally in your browser. It does not collect or sell personal data. Google Calendar sync sends only the events you export to your Google account.
